column8: ["All nineteen seats read as deep cups with dark upper inner walls and bright lower lips, breaking the straight-down view.","The seats carry directional shading and pale highlights; paint their curvature with concentric tones under even light so the lighting does not rotate with the machine.","The connecting channels are thin, dark, uneven cords between oversized rims; broaden them into clear, one-piece rubbed-brass links that remain readable beneath atoms."]
